_comment: Anchors tier (research/notes/PUBLIC_BENCH.md): the only tier with ground truth. truth = resident population in millions (2024 UN-flavored estimates, rounded — used only for the magnitude-calibration sidebar, never the headline). Items descending by truth. Memorizable by design; clearly labeled; never the headline. Harmonic block: four countries closely matched in population (48–55M) so the chordless-cycle judgments are genuinely hard.
